scoring: Each assertion is pass or fail based on a quoted fact or location in the actual output. Score equivalent behavior independently of specific phrasing.

level-blockout: Names a spatial sequence from entrance through lantern and pedestal to gate, with distinct direction or landmarks.
Uses the 1.2 m clearance boundary to exclude the 1.0 m route while carrying and proposes a cheap observation.
level-unaided: Starts fresh players at ordinary camera and entrance, reporting first route and cue before intervention.
Separates reachability or rehearsal from unaided discovery and proposes one cue or view comparison.
economy-flow: Derives 3 successful matches for the baseline and 2 for the candidate from 3 coins and increments of 3.
Names the progression owner and a tutorial-order guardrail or condition that stops adoption.
economy-existing-save: Provides an existing-save trace from 80 coins for both choices and a second load or migration control.
Keeps grandfathering versus truncation with the owner and names a falsifier such as duplicate loss or leaked value.
feel-trace: Separates the valid 72 ms input and 90 ms state confirmation from 155 ms sound and 430 ms recovery.
Offers a one-variable control and avoids inferring the cause of perceived latency from one trace.
feel-pause: Separates active-time clock, pause behavior and the ambiguity of the missing input queue or actual timebase.
Proposes a repeated paired trace with event ordering or queue observations capable of separating the hypotheses.
research-first-choice: Requires consent and starts an ordinary fresh session with neutral instructions and no coaching before first choice.
Defines intervention handling, eligible observation and a concrete owner decision or comparison.
research-mixed-exposure: Reports 4/8 and 5/7 fresh eligible counts while separately excluding coaching and absent opportunity.
Keeps causal attribution open because device, build or assignment differ and proposes a matched or randomized check.
catalog-source-pin: Pins pattern-overwatch r1 to trace-O and distinguishes pattern-warning-cone r2 and trace-W.
Names a candidate and unsuitable placement based on reaction trigger and clock.
catalog-alias-collision: Identifies both exact revisioned records and distinguishes hold/release from refill/spend.
Requires a placement-specific trigger or effective observation before approving either link.
